title: Y Combinator Jobs Search
description: Type a job title and press Start: you get the newest matching jobs at Y Combinator startups, from Work at a Startup (YC's job board, 6,300+ open jobs at 1,500 YC companies), each with its exact posting date. Every other field is optional. Press Start with the form empty for the newest jobs of every kind.

searchTerms.title: Job titles to find (searchTerms)
searchTerms.description: Type the job titles or keywords to find, one per line, for example software engineer or founding engineer. A job matches when its title has every word of a line: frontend also finds Front-End. Leave it empty for the newest jobs of every kind. A pasted YC job link is checked, a YC company link searches that company, and a ycombinator.com/jobs/role page searches its role and place.

location.title: Where the job is (location)
location.description: Type where the jobs should be: cities, states, countries or regions, one per line, for example San Francisco, New York, United States, India, Europe or Worldwide. A country finds its jobs and the jobs remote in it. Remote typed alone asks for remote jobs; typed next to a city it changes nothing, so pick remote in Remote or office for remote jobs only. Leave it empty for anywhere.

workType.title: Remote or office (workType)
workType.description: Pick remote, hybrid or onsite (at the office), or several. Leave it empty for all of them. A YC job that lists a Remote place, such as Remote (US), is remote; one that names only offices is onsite, and hybrid when its text says so. Typed words such as wfh or office work too.

postedWithin.title: Posted in the last (postedWithin)
postedWithin.description: Pick how new the jobs must be: posted in the last 24 hours, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days. 30 days, the default, keeps the last month's jobs, newest first; any time keeps every open job, some posted years ago (86% of YC's open jobs are older than a month). The date is each job's exact posting time from its YC page. You can also type your own period, such as 48 hours or 2 weeks.

role.title: Job role (role)
role.description: Pick the job role: the role areas YC files every job under: engineering, design, product, science, sales, marketing, support, operations, recruiting, finance or legal, or a kind of engineering: backend, frontend, full-stack, machine-learning, ai-engineer, data-science, devops, mobile (iOS and Android), hardware or robotics. Leave it empty for every role. Same as the role filter of Work at a Startup.

experienceYears.title: Experience (experienceYears)
experienceYears.description: Type your years of experience: a number such as 3, a range such as 2-5, 5+ for five or more, or fresher. YC states a minimum for each job (3+ years, or Any for new grads), and a job is kept when its minimum is at or below your years: 3 keeps 1+ and 3+ years and leaves out 5+. Internships ask for students and count as 0 years. Leave it empty for every experience.

batch.title: YC batch (batch)
batch.description: Pick the YC batches whose companies' jobs to keep, such as W25 (Winter 2025) or S24 (Summer 2024), or a year (2025 keeps all its batches). F is Fall and P is Spring (X25 works too). You can type any batch, such as S21 or Winter 2016. Leave it empty for every batch.

companyStage.title: Company stage (companyStage)
companyStage.description: Pick the company stages to keep, as YC's directory states them: early (most YC startups), growth or public. Leave it empty for every stage.

teamSize.title: Team size (teamSize)
teamSize.description: Pick or type the company's team size, as YC's directory states it: a range such as 1-10 or 11-50, 1000+ for a thousand or more, or one number. Leave it empty for every size.

minSalaryUsd.title: Minimum pay, USD (minSalaryUsd)
minSalaryUsd.description: Type the minimum yearly pay in US dollars, for example 150000: a job is kept when the top of its pay range reaches it (hourly and monthly pay count as a year's). Jobs that show no pay, or pay in another currency (EUR, GBP, INR, CAD), are left out. Leave it empty for every pay.

withEquity.title: Only with equity (withEquity)
withEquity.description: Tick to keep only jobs that offer equity (stock options), with the range YC shows, such as 0.25% - 1.00%: 29% of YC's open jobs on 2026-11-10.

visa.title: Visa terms (visa)
visa.description: Pick the visa terms to keep, as each YC job states them: will-sponsor (the company sponsors a US visa), not-required (no US citizenship or visa needed, such as jobs outside the US) or us-only (US citizen or visa holder only). Leave it empty for every job.

maxJobs.title: Number of jobs (maxJobs)
maxJobs.description: Type how many jobs to get, newest first: 100 by default. Type 0 to get every matching job. Each job is one charged row, so this sets the most a run can cost.

includeDetails.title: Full details (includeDetails)
includeDetails.description: Tick to add the full details of each job: the description as text and HTML, whether it offers equity, and the city, state and country of its first place. A job with details is charged as a Job with details row.

excludeTerms.title: Leave out words (excludeTerms)
excludeTerms.description: Type words that leave a job out when its title has them, one per line, for example senior or intern. Leave it empty to keep every job.

employmentType.title: Job type (employmentType)
employmentType.description: Pick the job type: full-time, contract or internship, or several. Leave it empty for every job type. YC's job types are full-time, internship, contract and co-founder.

searchDescriptions.title: Wider match (searchDescriptions)
searchDescriptions.description: Tick for a wider match: a job is also kept when its description holds your words as a phrase, not only its title. python then also finds a Backend Engineer job that asks for Python. Slower: each job that can match is opened.

companies.title: Only these companies (companies)
companies.description: Type YC company names to search only their jobs, one per line, as YC's directory writes them: Airbnb, Brex, Retool. A company link (ycombinator.com/companies/brex) or a companySlug from a row works too. Leave it empty to search every YC company that is hiring.

jobUrls.title: Job links to check (jobUrls)
jobUrls.description: Paste YC job links (ycombinator.com/companies/.../jobs/...) or Work at a Startup job links (workatastartup.com/jobs/123456) to check whether they are still open, one per line, instead of searching. Each comes back open with the job, closed (the company no longer lists it) or not found.
